answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 27845 Country: India Title: Please advise whether it is also required to perform khatna (circumcision) of a new born baby boy before performing his aqeeqah or simply shaving of his hair is ok. Question: Assalamualaikum, Janab please advise whether it is also required to perform khatna (circumcision) of a new born baby boy before performing his aqeeqah or simply shaving of his hair is ok. Also, if it is difficult even to shave the hair of the baby due to health concerns can we still perform the Aqeeqah. Answer ID: 27845 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1855/1333/L=1431) (1) It is not necessary to perform khatna (circumcision) first, only shaving hair is enough. (2) Aqiqah may be done without shaving hair. However, if there is no compulsion, it is mustahab to shave hair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
